links.note: Draft only. Analysis implementation, reference audit, qualified pilot estimates, immutable image, checkpoint admission, pricing and independent replay remain prerequisites. Earlier correctness pilots are disclosed; no new benchmark timing has been collected.

question: For the p109 and p157 public cubic-extension fixtures, what are the complete cold costs of the actual native transfer implementations and the named direct source-rho controls, under observed L2 and matched A/A?

claims.text: Each accepted run must recover a scalar checked on its original source curve and against its separately held known-answer receipt.
Compare the concrete full-transfer IC and target-rho implementations to the matched direct source-rho-neg implementation on each fixture, conditional on complete admission.
Universal transfer coverage, asymptotic complexity, scaling from two fields, strongest-ever implementation and an overall ECDLP security conclusion are outside this experiment.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Every target is independently generated with a withheld known scalar; each completed solve must pass original-source multiplication and a separate source_public verification, and match the held receipt. A wrong answer invalidates comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: This measures costs of named implementations on public known-answer instances. No prevalence or null-population detection claim is made.

factors.name: source_fixtures
factors.how: Stratify all estimates and decisions by original source curve; never pool the two fields as a scaling series.

factors.name: public_targets
factors.value: 8 targets per curve; generation seeds 500001109 and 500001157
factors.how: source_public generate uses its frozen native law, independently of arm. Hold scalar receipts outside solver APIs.

factors.name: measurement_instrument
factors.value: one source-bound runner, observation library and OCI image
factors.how: All arms use the same runner and resident collector; selected algorithm payload is part of the concrete implementation treatment, not an algorithm-only causal claim.

factors.name: payload_builds
factors.value: same source revision and frozen release build recipes
factors.how: Pin every payload/library hash; verify actual executed inode and public input hashes before/after. No claim separates language or compiler effects from the concrete implementation.

factors.name: nuisance_seed
factors.how: One explicit seed per measured round, shared across its arms. A/A uses exactly the same rho-neg seed.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: Within each target/round, sort arm labels by SHA256 of the frozen order-domain/seed/prime/target/warmup/arm tuple; independent of observed results.

factors.name: threads_and_resources
factors.value: one algorithm thread; one 4-CPU/8Gi L2 Spot Job
factors.how: Guaranteed placement; native reservation, actual affinity and thread observations; default grading thresholds only.

factors.name: cold_state
factors.value: fresh process and fresh transfer/factor-base state for every row
factors.how: Warmups never supply retained algebraic state to a measured process.

factors.name: host_conditions
factors.how: Host class, PSI, steal, intruders, scheduler delay, switches, IRQs, NUMA pages, binary identities and all blockers retained per execution.

factors.name: spot_interruption
factors.how: Preserve an interrupted row and its counts, invalidate its clock and stop; do not silently resume or retry a timed interval.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Freeze native analysis code and its hash before affected data; pending in this draft.

seed_derivation.note: Warmup uses 2026110500. Measured round j uses 2026110500+j. Order keys are SHA256(UTF8('cubic-cold-order-v1|'+seed+'|'+prime+'|'+target_id+'|'+warmup_bit+'|'+arm_id)), sorted by hex digest then arm id. A/A shares the underlying rho-neg seed.

instance_sampling.rule: Eight distinct nontrivial native source_public targets per curve, with seeds 500001109/500001157; retain the exact generator version and generated public input hashes.

blinding.how: Named implementation diagnostics; unblinded analysis and its limitations are declared before data.

power.note: Eight target clusters per field, all five repeated nuisance rounds within each cluster. A descriptive bounded panel; power for small effects is not established. Do not treat 40 repeats as 40 independent targets. Two candidate/reference comparisons in two strata form a four-comparison family.

primary.name: Complete cold process wall interval
primary.definition: Parent interval immediately before spawning through wait4 reap: native runtime/load, public input parsing, all cold construction/calibration/failures/retries/inversion, target solving, recovery, in-process source verification and process exit. Target generation, harness preflight/hash work and separate audit verification are recorded outside this interval.
primary.resolution: 1 ns recorded; actual monotonic clock resolution and A/A spread must be observed

secondary.name: Resident native algorithm interval
secondary.definition: Resident hook inside main before argument/input parsing to scope exit. Includes native setup/retries/verification, excludes runtime loader and collector publication; not an online-only interval.

secondary.name: Maximum child RSS
secondary.definition: Linux wait4 ru_maxrss of the child process; not cumulative allocation traffic.

counters: full checked PMU lifecycle, including unsupported/denied outcomes; no invented complete coverage

memory policy and anonymous page placement

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The user explicitly requested complete cold pipeline elapsed cost; current field and target-call counters do not price the entire FLINT/Singular/native path. Use observed L2 and matched A/A for clocks, preserve unknown complete GAE/PMU coverage and admit no S or security claim from these timers. Complete pricing/replay requirements still gate any performance promotion.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed panel: 2 curves x 8 targets x 5 arms x 5 measured rounds = 400 executions, plus 80 fresh-process warmups.

Stop at the original 21600-second global deadline, USD5 inclusive attempt ceiling, exhausted/unknown live shared budget, interruption, or a wrong source answer; retain every attempted and unattempted row. No automatic measurement retry.

invalidation_rules: Any wrong answer, missing source check, failed A/A, missing/failed L2 or incomplete frozen instrument/analysis admission prevents a decisive comparison; do not cherry-pick surviving rows.
Timeouts and failures are reported as censored/incomplete outcomes, never replaced by the timeout bound as an exact solve cost.

Unpriced native work and partial target counters cannot become a complete GAE/S value. No comparative promotion before applicable pricing, matched-reference and independent replay requirements are met.

decision_rule.text: Draft decision plan: per curve, compare paired cold-process costs over eight independent target clusters, retaining five nuisance rounds per cluster. Report 95% descriptive cluster-bootstrap intervals and preregistered Bonferroni-adjusted 98.75% decision intervals (four comparisons). A directional descriptive effect must exceed the matched A/A envelope as well as exclude ratio 1. Invalid/incomplete measurement or pricing admission yields invalid_measurement/inconclusive, never a winner. Freeze the actual native analysis and strongest-applicable reference review before collecting affected timing data.
decision_rule.threshold: All admission gates; adjusted ratio interval excludes 1 and effect lies outside matched A/A envelope.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-field ratio of summed paired cold times, with target-cluster resampling; no cross-field pooling.
decision_rule.interval: 10000 deterministic target-cluster bootstrap resamples; implementation and seed must be frozen before data.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Cold process cost ratio and paired difference per field

inadmissible: Launching with unknown live budget/capacity or missing authorization.
Substituting synthetic Jacobian targets or the deployed validation fixture for the real native transfer.
Calling command-Job completion or an L2 placement label observed L2 admission.
Replacing complete cold cost with target-only/amortized/online-only cost.
Treating partial counters or non-admitted PMU records as complete native GAE/instruction pricing.
Selecting new targets/seeds/attempts or weakening grading after observing results.
Scaling, universal coverage, fastest-known or security conclusions from these two fields.
